# cburnett chess pieces

These SVG piece images are by Colin M. L. Burnett (the "cburnett" set), originally created for Wikipedia and used by Lichess as their default piece set.

- Source: https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece/cburnett
- Original Wikipedia source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:Cburnett
- License: GFDL / CC BY-SA 3.0 (per the Wikipedia uploads)

Used here unmodified.
